resources.string: Shows the Bloviate dictation bubble when a text field is focused and hides it on password fields. Bloviate only detects that a field is focused — it never reads the text you type.
On — Bloviate can spot text fields in other apps
Off — Bloviate can’t tell when you’re typing yet
This is how Bloviate knows when to offer the dictation bubble. Bloviate only notices which app you’re in and what kind of field it is — it never reads what you type.
Right now: you’re in a text field
Right now: a password field (bubble stays hidden)
Floating over other apps: not allowed yet

Turn the bubble on, then tap a text field in any app — the bubble floats next to it. It never appears on password fields. Drag it to move it (it remembers the spot), or drag it to the bottom of the screen to put it away for that field.
The dictation bubble appears over editable text fields.
Off — Bloviate needs the microphone to hear your dictation
Your voice is turned into text right on this phone. Nothing is recorded, and no audio ever leaves the device.
Covers 99 languages — the pick for anything beyond Parakeet’s list · About 148 MB
Best for English and 25 European languages · About 640 MB · Usually the most accurate
%1$s selected — using %2$s until the %1$s model downloads
Voice models run entirely on this phone — your audio never leaves the device. A model can be used as soon as it shows as downloaded.

Change the bubble’s color, size, and shape — coming soon.
AI styles rewrite your dictation through OpenRouter using your own key. The key is stored encrypted on this phone and is only ever sent to OpenRouter — never anywhere else.
Key saved on this phone — AI styles are on.
No key — AI styles stay off until you add one.
Add your OpenRouter key above to use this style.
Words with their correct spelling and capitalization. Whenever one of these shows up in your dictation, Bloviate writes it exactly like this.
No words yet. Add the names and words Bloviate keeps getting wrong.
When Bloviate hears this, it should write that. Fixes for the mis-hearings that keep happening.
No corrections yet. When Bloviate writes a word wrong the same way twice, teach it the fix here.
That word is already in your dictionary.
Fill in both sides — what Bloviate hears, and what it should write.
There’s already a correction for that. Remove it first if you want a different one.
Those are the same — a correction has to change the word.
